title: Set up your phone number
blurb: Get a business number for calls and texts, and set call forwarding.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Add a number
steps.body: Click **Add Number**. Choose **New Zealand**, search by area code (for example **3** for Christchurch or **9** for Auckland), then pick a number you like.
steps.tip: See **Your phone system requires configuration**? We need to switch it on for you. Email hello@luubu.com.

steps.title: Forward calls to your mobile
steps.body: Click your new number to edit it. Under **Forward calls to**, enter your mobile so calls ring you wherever you are. Turn on **call recording** and **voicemail** if you want them.

steps.title: Try it out
steps.body: Pick a contact and send yourself a text. Replies come back into **Conversations**, so your whole team sees them.
steps.awayText: Last step: let's try your new number in **Conversations**.
